question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1566 (Phishing)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: MITRE ATT&CK lists several mitigations for Phishing (T1566). These include Audit (M1047), Software Configuration (M1054), Antivirus/Antimalware (M1049), User Training (M1017), Restrict Web-Based Content (M1021), and Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031).
